rules:
What may touch: the gripper and whatever group it is picking up, holding or putting down, within 4 s of the
    grasp or release; a held part and the groups it touches when it is taken and when it is let go (where it came
    from and where it goes).
method: FCL 0.7 (python-fcl) mesh-mesh collision on the drawn meshes, arm links decimated to 8000 triangles; every frame of the clip, after its update
audited: sub-steps from '4/5' up to, not including, '5/5' only (frames before were run but not checked), at 6 fps, VLAB_ONLY_TRAYS=F
